thought.text: All components verified end-to-end. Let me do a final consolidated check, including the XML export job that runs at startup (good proof the Quartz jobs + DB export path work).

reasoning_content:
Everything is working end-to-end:
1. Frontend serving the Angular app at http://localhost:4200 (title "Leipziger Strassennamen")
2. Development config with correct endpointUrl and keycloak config being served
3. CORS preflight from the frontend origin is allowed
4. Actual CORS responses including Authorization work

Let me run a final comprehensive verification to confirm all components are up and the whole flow works. Let me check:
- Keycloak is running and configured
- Frontend is serving
- Backend is serving with auth
- CORS works
- Database with migrations applied

Let me do one final consolidated check to gather evidence.

Also, the guide mentioned that the XmlExportStrassen job runs once at startup. Let me check whether the export file was created. That's a good sign that the Quartz job and DB export are working.

action.command:
echo "=== Containers ==="; docker ps --format "{{.Names}}\t{{.Image}}\t{{.Status}}" | grep -E "keycloak|mssql"
echo "=== Export file (generated at startup by XmlExportStrassen job) ==="; ls -la /workspace/src/Backend/Lecos.Strassennamen.RestAPI/Export/ 2>/dev/null
echo "=== DB tables created by migrations ==="; docker exec mssql /opt/mssql-tools18/bin/sqlcmd -S localhost -U sa -P 'Strassen#2024' -C -d Strassennamen -Q "SELECT name FROM sys.tables ORDER BY name" 2>/dev/null
echo "=== Processes listening ==="; (ss -ltnp 2>/dev/null || netstat -ltnp 2>/dev/null) | grep -E ":4200|:5000|:8080|:1433"
